title: Sumitomo Osaka Cement raises 2027 financial year profit forecast following second quarter growth
summary: Sumitomo Osaka Cement raises 2027 financial year profit forecast following second quarter growth
body_markdown:
**Japan:** Sumitomo Osaka Cement has announced its financial results for the second quarter of the 2027 fiscal year, from 1 July 2026 – 30 September 2026. The consolidated ordinary profit for the second quarter of the fiscal year ending March 2027 rose to US$40.2m, an increase by 51% year-on-year compared to the same period in 2025, exceeding the previous forecast of US$27m.


The full-year 2026 forecast for consolidated ordinary profit has been revised upward by 2.1% year-on-year, from the previous forecast of US$91.2m to US$93m, increasing the growth rate from 0.7% to 2.7% year-on-year.
